Making a vegan lasagna from scratch is easy and delicious. Follow these simple steps to make your own vegan lasagna at home:

Ingredients needed:

- 1 package lasagna noodles
- 3 cups vegan tomato sauce
- 2 cups of vegan ricotta cheese
- 1 package of vegan mozzarella cheese
- 2 cups of spinach
- 1 yellow onion, diced
- 4 garlic cloves, minced
- 1 tablespoon olive oil
- Salt and black pepper to taste

Directions:

1. Preheat your oven to 350°F.

2. Cook the lasagna noodles according to package instructions, then drain and rinse with cold water.

3. In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium heat. Add the diced onion and minced garlic to the skillet and sauté for 5-7 minutes until the onions are translucent.

4. Add the spinach to the skillet and sauté until it has wilted. Remove from heat.

5. In a separate bowl, mix the vegan ricotta cheese, 1 cup of the vegan mozzarella cheese, salt, and pepper until well combined.

6. Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish with cooking spray.

7. Spread a thin layer of vegan tomato sauce in the bottom of the baking dish.

8. Add a layer of cooked lasagna noodles on top of the sauce, making sure they slightly overlap.

9. Add a layer of the spinach and onion mixture on top of the lasagna, followed by a layer of the cheese mixture.

10. Repeat layers of noodles, sauce, spinach mixture, and cheese until all the ingredients are used up.

11. Top with a layer of vegan mozzarella cheese.

12. Cover with aluminum foil and bake for 20 minutes. Remove the foil and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes or until the cheese is golden and bubbly.

13. Remove from the oven and let the lasagna sit for 5-10 minutes before serving.
